# 禅道Bug 6358 菜单管理操作项截断
zhi2-web-admin 系统管理→菜单管理页「操作」列按钮在奇安信(QAX)可信浏览器被表格右边缘截断，已修复合入 develop/v3.0.0。

## 现象
- Bug 6358（http://zentao-biz.zhi.com/index.php?m=bug&f=view&bugID=6358），2026-11-09 提出，禅道 resolved（效果「已实施待联调」；本机 Chrome 无法复现奇安信旧内核，需客测确认）
- 「操作」列（新增/编辑/删除）由 `zs-operate-column` 渲染，width 由 `zs-table` JS 计算（stretch/width），非固定 CSS，列宽≈182px 足够 3 按钮，非换行问题
- 浏览器：奇安信(QAX)可信浏览器，旧 Chromium 内核，字体度量略大→列宽测量偏大更易触发

## 根因与修复
- 根因（机制 B）：`zs-table` 内容滚动模式加 `.zs-table-container--content-scroll` 并把 `.el-table` 设 `width:max-content` 变宽；父级 `.list-card{overflow:hidden}` 裁掉变宽部分，右侧 fixed 操作列被窗口右缘截断无滚动条；现代浏览器 contentScrollActive 不激活零影响
- 修复：`zhi2-web-admin/src/components/zs-table/zs-table.vue` 新增 `.zs-table-container--content-scroll{overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:hidden}` 与子级 `.el-table{width:max-content;min-width:100%}`，容器自身承担横向滚动
- 提交 `c838c35f2`（fix(zs-table): content-scroll 容器横向滚动，修复奇安信旧内核下操作列被裁断(禅道#6358)），推送 `origin/fix/bug-6358`；`npm run build`（vite 8.3.5）退出码 0，产物 dist/assets/zs-table-Bn60CwI3.css 第 1 行含 `.zs-table-container--content-scroll[data-v-3388c7c3]{overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:hidden}`

## 合入与推送
- 子模块 zhi2-web-admin：develop/v3.0.0 ff 到 `200124782`（含 bug6363）再 merge fix/bug-6358 → `05a1a4421`，已推送
- 父仓「苏州市房地产监测V3」（remote 实际 zhi3-web-admin-h5-g-unlimited）：`224b87d` 推送被拒，rebase 后于 `99f511e`/`956cdca` 之上 `f2ea8cd` 更新 gitlink（指向 05a1a4421）；`0245da5` docs 新增台账 E-045（docs/frontend/common-errors.md）
- 主工作区无关改动（`M env/.env`、8 个 eslint-rules/* 未提交删除、`.tmp-bug-6324.png`）git stash 暂存；eslint-rules 删除存于 zhi2-web-admin `stash@{0}`，既有 `stash@{1} temp-6235` 未触碰
- worktree `zhi2-web-admin-wt-6358` 已删，node_modules 软链已移除

## 禅道回写与关联
- zt_bug 6358：status=resolved、resolution=fixed、resolvedBuild=trunk、resolvedBy=tiany、resolvedDate=2026-11-09 18:03:48、assignedTo=zhunan
- zt_action 89610：action=resolved、extra=fixed，备注含根因+修复+验证+提交号；DBX 事务内与提交后双校验落库

# ZenTao Bug 6363
ZenTao defect 6363: attachment loss on company basic-info detail page when the company record is under admin review for a change; fixed and resolved on 2026-11-09.

## Description
- Module: 开发企业 → 企业基本信息 → 变更审核中 (submitted, awaiting admin approval) detail page.
- Symptom: attachments uploaded at change submission were lost on the detail page.

## Root Cause
- Attachment query used filing-dimension code `BUS_CODE = 040100` + `companyRecordId` instead of change-dimension code `qybgxq` + `changeId`.
- `DeveloperBasicInfoDetail.vue` `displayAppendixBusCode()` only switched between entry-page and filing-dimension codes, missing the change-under-review dimension.

## Fix
- File: `zhi2-web-admin/src/views/company/companyManagement/components/DeveloperBasicInfoDetail.vue`
- Added `displayAppendixAtChangeDimension` reusing `companyRecord.js` `isCompanyRecordChangeUnderAdminReview`.
- `displayAppendixBusCode()` now returns `DEVELOPER_CHANGE_APPENDIX_BUS_CODE` (`qybgxq`) for change-under-review; `displayAppendixBusId()` already switched to `changeId`.
- Commit: submodule `2001247828766ff771bc6eb561adafcbb9ebbc9c` (submodule `develop/v3.0.0` tip), parent gitlink `99f511e`.

## Resolution
- ZenTao write-back via DBX "新禅道" (mysql `192.168.1.87:13306`/zentao, connection `4027e274-2f63-49e6-8a8d-5f25eb1e6c5e`): `UPDATE zt_bug SET status='resolved', resolution='fixed', resolvedBy='tiany', resolvedDate='2026-11-09' WHERE id=6363;`
- Verified: status=resolved, resolution=fixed, resolvedBy=tiany, resolvedDate=2026-11-09.
